Two standard decks plus jokers. The shuffle button runs the same algorithm as
`game/Deck.js` - unbiased, every order equally likely - which is the whole
answer to "is the shuffle fair?" in the {doc}`../faq`.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Cards in play | **110** (2 standard decks + jokers) |
| Jokers | **6** |
| Cards dealt per player | **15** |
| Players | **2 - 4** |

## Card values

| Card | | Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Queen of Spades (Pik Dame) | <span class="pd-card queen" title="Q♠, 100 points"><span class="pd-rk">Q</span><span class="pd-st">♠</span></span> | **100** |
| Joker | <span class="pd-card joker" title="Joker, 20 points"><span class="pd-rk">JK</span><span class="pd-st">★</span></span> | **20** |
| Ace | <span class="pd-card red" title="A♥, 20 points"><span class="pd-rk">A</span><span class="pd-st">♥</span></span> | **20** |
| 10, Jack, Queen, King | <span class="pd-card" title="10♣, 10 points"><span class="pd-rk">10</span><span class="pd-st">♣</span></span> <span class="pd-card" title="J♣, 10 points"><span class="pd-rk">J</span><span class="pd-st">♣</span></span> <span class="pd-card" title="Q♣, 10 points"><span class="pd-rk">Q</span><span class="pd-st">♣</span></span> <span class="pd-card" title="K♣, 10 points"><span class="pd-rk">K</span><span class="pd-st">♣</span></span> | **10** |
| 2 - 9 | <span class="pd-card red" title="2♦, 5 points"><span class="pd-rk">2</span><span class="pd-st">♦</span></span> <span class="pd-card red" title="9♦, 5 points"><span class="pd-rk">9</span><span class="pd-st">♦</span></span> | **5** |

## Combinations

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Set (same rank) | 3 - **8** cards, each suit at most **2×** (two decks) |
| Run (same suit) | 3 - **13** cards, circular: `K-A-2` is valid, no rank twice |

Runs live on a ring: after the king comes the ace, after the ace the two. A
run may start anywhere on it and use at most every rank once.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  r0(("2"))
  r1(("3"))
  r2(("4"))
  r3(("5"))
  r4(("6"))
  r5(("7"))
  r6(("8"))
  r7(("9"))
  r8(("10"))

  r10(("Q"))
  r11(("K"))
  r12(("A"))

  r1 --> r2
  r2 --> r3
  r3 --> r4
  r4 --> r5
  r5 --> r6
  r6 --> r7
  r7 --> r8
  r8 --> r9
  r9 --> r10
  r10 --> r11
  r11 --> r12
  r12 --> r0
```

## Scoring

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Game ends at | **1000** points |
| `handAusDoubles` (default) | `false` - going out in one turn doubles the round score |
| `strictThreshold` (default) | `false` - if true the game ends only *above* 1000, not *at* it |

The winner of a round scores only their melds. Everyone else scores
*melds minus the cards left in hand* - so a Queen of Spades caught in hand costs
**100** points.
